notes: All room sizes read from zoom-4 crops; wall faces read off crop rulers (about +/-1.5 px per face). span was not used for the scale because it measures to traced wall lines about 2-4 px beyond the interior faces and overshot through untraced/closet walls (Bedroom 5 height 222 vs 169, Bedroom 4 height 205 vs 173); span on Owner's Suite gives 239 px = 12.63 px/ft, which is likely how the tracer got 12.61. Printed sizes and both overall dimension strings agree at about 12.4 px/ft, so the tracer scale is about 1.6% high (about 3% in area). All three levels are at the same scale (rooms from first floor, second floor and lower level agree). Exercise Room is the low outlier (12.27/12.24), its left wall face is ambiguous by ~4 px. Missing walls: Bedroom 5 south wall and Owner's Suite south-west wall stub are confirmed by span passing through; the Bedroom 2 east / fireplace wall entry is from span passing through at y=850-930 although the overview appears to show red there, so treat it as uncertain. Span also passes through the Owner's Suite north wall at x=1450-1500 (not listed, overview shows red). No clear extra walls found; the red outlines on the lower level follow drawn unfinished-basement foundation walls. Great room north side is sliding glass and great room/kitchen is open with columns, so no walls are missing there.
